caveats.en: Recent Madden releases use EA Javelin anti-cheat, which requires x86 Windows and makes them unplayable on Arm PCs for now. EA says Javelin reaches RTX Spark in early 2027.
caveats.zh-TW: 近年的 Madden 都使用 EA Javelin 反作弊，它需要 x86 版 Windows，所以目前在 Arm 電腦上無法遊玩。EA 表示 Javelin 會在 2027 年初支援 RTX Spark。

evidence.title: Notebookcheck: Javelin requires x86 Windows; Battlefield, EA Sports, Madden use it
